title: Nourishing Canadian Tart Pudding
description: A gooey, indulgent lacto-vegetarian-friendly dessert featuring a rich tomato puree, tempered chocolate, and a crunchy oat topping.

ingredients.name: Dark brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality sugar for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.notes: Use whole milk for a richer flavor

ingredients.name: Tempering chocolate
ingredients.notes: Milk chocolate or semisweet chocolate can be used

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for a fluffier texture

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a rich flavor

instructions: Grease a 9-inch (23cm) round baking dish and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, tomato puree, cocoa powder, and salt.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and milk.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm sugar mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly.
While the pudding is baking, prepare the oat topping by mixing the oat flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Add the butter and honey (if using) to the bowl and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
When the pudding is done, remove it from the oven and sprinkle the oat topping evenly over the top.
Return the pudding to the oven and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
